text:
alice-ops: Heads up — we'll be doing a short, rolling maintenance tomorrow to apply a kernel micropatch on a subset of serving nodes. Target start: 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC, expected duration per AZ ~15–25m. No full-region drains planned, just targeted node reboots.

ben-oncall: @alice-ops thanks — are we expecting any customer-facing throttles or elevated latencies during the reboots?

alice-ops: @ben-oncall minimal. Autoscale policies will handle typical load but there might be transient 100–500ms tail latency spikes for a small percentage of requests while the node pool rebalances. We'll put a note on statuspage.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: Scheduled maintenance created — ID MNT-2026-042. Pager escalation will NOT be triggered for this maintenance unless error rate > 3% sustained for 5m. See /ops/maint runbook.

carla-sre: Quick ask — can we avoid performing this in eu-west1 from 02:00–02:30 UTC? traffic there still looks high in last 2 weeks. Suggest order: us-west -> us-east -> eu-west.

alice-ops: good call. Updated plan: us-west1, us-central1, us-east1, then eu-west1 last. Posting revised start times in the status copy.

lisa-cs: Draft customer note for review: "Tomorrow we will perform a brief maintenance on our inference serving nodes to apply a security micropatch. Most customers will not notice any impact; a small fraction of requests may see slightly higher latency for up to ~30 minutes while traffic shifts between nodes. No action required. Status page will be updated at start and completion." Thoughts?

dave-product: LGTM. Can we add a sentence about fallbacks: "If your app is latency-sensitive, consider switching to dedicated capacity during the maintenance window"?

alice-ops: added fallback line and a short QA:

```
Start: 2026-04-12 02:00 UTC
Estimated per-AZ time: 15-25m
Impact: brief tail latency spikes for <5% requests; no expected errors
Escalation: auto only if 5m sustained error rate >3%
```

carla-sre: tagging rollout owners: @ben-oncall will lead oncall for the window, @carla-sre will monitor KV cache health, @alice-ops will post statuspage updates.

ben-oncall: Oncall acked. I'll have the quick mitigation play ready: revert routing to standby pool + manual cache warm if we see >2% token errors.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Oncall schedule confirmed. Pager routing unchanged.

lisa-cs: I'll queue the customer email to go out 4 hours prior and include the exact times per region once you confirm final ordering. Also preparing a short support blurb for CS templates.

alice-ops: final check: anyone expect a dependent deploy or heavy traffic spike in that window? @dave-product?

dave-product: Nothing scheduled from product side. We also set an internal freeze for feature deploys during that 6-hour window.

carla-sre: Ok. After maintenance completes, we'll verify: 1) per-route p50/p95 latencies, 2) error-rate baseline, 3) KV cache hit ratio. If any regression >10% at p95 we open an incident.

alice-ops: copied. I'll post the statuspage draft now and tag here when it's live. Thanks all — small window but want to be explicit about ordering and CS copy. :wave:
